source: Raw evidence basis: managed-record-multiclient SSE capture via corpusctl --mode managed-record-multiclient at candidate 67718bc0342cc631f5fb963678b58f8338e0ca28 (clean tree; fu01-query-a.ndjson, fu01-query-b.ndjson, fu01-query-c.ndjson, fu01-capture-facts.json), which established the retained-frame shape (protocol-init excluding the transport handshake, add-query-ok, ordered whole-result refresh-ok) and the deterministic facts replayed exactly below: a single committed admin change lands as trigger transaction watermark tx-id 2 on a fresh isolated database (seed tx 1), and both streams go quiet inside a bounded 250ms window. This envelope's checked-in bytes are captured live from cmd/instantd/runtime_fu01_query_replay_test.go::TestFU01QueryCaptureReplay running that same shape against the owned deterministic query-concurrency-gap fixture (app 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003, fixed entity IDs, per docs/plans/finish-up/fu01-multiclient-capture-contract.md §2a) rather than replaying the recorder's random per-run UUIDs verbatim; the contract's shape-proof harness TestFU01CaptureContractQueryConcurrency and the accepted assembled leg TestCF003AssembledSSEQueryConcurrencyOrderedSnapshot share this same deterministic entity/title/event-id convention.
redaction: CF-002 discipline: volatile transport headers excluded; SSE heartbeat comment records excluded; the transport-level handshake hello frame (machine-id/session-id/sse-token) is excluded from retention per contract §3 — only frames observed after the client's own init POST are retained. Masking rule (mechanical, enforced by the replay test): session-bearing and schema-minted string values are never checked in. The checked-in frames carry sentinel placeholders <fu01-session-A>, <fu01-session-B>, <fu01-attr-id-todos-id>, <fu01-attr-id-todos-title> in exactly the positions the live server emits random values (protocol-init session-id per subscriber, schema attr ids). Entity IDs, the app ID, titles, op names, and event IDs are fixed literals chosen by the owned fixture and are never masked; they remain comparison-significant. The replay test substitutes no values into request bodies (this envelope carries no POST byte capture, since the SSE POST responses for this flow are always exactly {}\n regardless of session content and add no evidentiary value over the retained stream) and masks live frames back to the sentinels before whole-result reflect.DeepEqual; any checked-in real session value (any live-session-prefix substring) or missing sentinel fails the test before any byte is replayed. No timestamps, DSNs, or database URLs appear in these bytes.
excluded: Excluded with reason: (1) the transport handshake hello — excluded from retention by contract §3, asserted only for distinctness/freshness live, never checked in. (2) The seed admin transact (POST /admin/transact, three entities in one call) — its response carries a per-database transaction watermark and its request carries the credential-bearing X-admin-token header; it runs live with a positive strictly-advancing tx-id asserted live (deterministic tx-id 1 on a fresh isolated database, re-asserted exactly). (3) SSE POST request/response bytes for init and add-query — always exactly 200 {}\n regardless of session content; the cf003 helpers already assert this exactly live, so raw byte capture here would only smuggle random session tokens for zero comparison value. Heartbeat comments are excluded per the redaction rule, not a behavior exclusion.
